sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-29 and 2016-12-29, cardholder C08106 experienced unauthorized activity on card C08106-K1. A total of 1 transaction(s) amounting to $128.33 USD were executed under fraud pattern 'card_not_present_new_device'. The primary flagged transaction 3583227 ($128.33) was initiated through the online channel. Activity originated from a device profile (UnknownDevice | UnknownOS | firefox 47.0 | UnknownScreen) marked as New for this account. The same device profile was also observed across 6 other distinct cards, demonstrating coordinated compromise. The cardholder was contacted for transaction validation and stated: 'Customer states they did not make these purchases and still has the card'. The activity represents a coordinated breach consistent with regulatory typology guidance. The financial institution has blocked card C08106-K1 to mitigate further loss and placed linked accounts under enhanced monitoring.

stop_reason: Customer denial and definitive graph pattern signatures settled the verdict; further steps would not alter the defensive actions.
